findings: MLX full attention on NAX available hardware and D64/128/256 enters NAX. kU=16 but Ktile<T,2,1> load spans32 rows, so a simple base pointer remap cannot preserve arbitrary page16 order; split per16row fragment loading must retain original MMA/softmax/reduction. Vtile<T,1,2> has16row fragments.

MLX vector onepass and2pass also need mapped logical K/V rows; old Metal steel BlockLoaderT is a separate actual path. NAX dsplit loops also exist and cannot be silently left under a generic paged eligibility claim.

ggml host push constants already32*4=128 bytes at guaranteed Vulkan cap. Native page16 mapping must use shader/pipeline identity/constant fields without growing ordinary push constant layout; physical buffer bounds and logicalKV must stay distinct.

Pristine Vulkan has scalar/coopmat1/coopmat2 loads, including matrix loads spanning pages. However HYLE FULL_F32 tag explicitly selects scalar tuning and f32 shader, suppresses dequant/repack. Therefore the existing qualified HYLE F16 page domain must preserve this scalar math route; existing normal cooperative paths are not to be rewritten or claimed newly qualified.

Existing MaterializedNativeState is compute_batch owned in centralized component graph. It owns metadata banks, exact frame comparison, admission and native retirement for both typed native routes; new page metadata controller must reuse/refactor this owner rather than clone a second coordinator.

Current Vulkan carrier maps BF16 but existing public SDPA/full tag eligibility is F16/F32; native BF16 payload support alone is not whole HYLE BF16 attention support. Actual accepted dtype/output conversion domain must be frozen before AUDITED, not inferred from shader comments.
